title: Sort a file and save to a new file
summary: Sort the lines of a text file and write the result to a specified output file. This can be used to sort a file in-place if the output file is the same as the input.

steps.explain: Use the --output flag to specify where to save the sorted lines.

placeholders.name: OUTPUT_FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the file where sorted lines will be saved.

placeholders.name: INPUT_FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the file you want to sort.
